mara (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock acceptance criteria for the Optimize toolkit pilot (batching/caching/quant + eval-triggered alerts). Goal: pilot with 3 customers by EoQ. Thoughts?
kevin (eng): Ack. Need measurement hooks for per-route token saving + latency histograms.
aj (eng-ml): +1. Also add model-level quant recommendation table: expected token savings vs quality delta (p95 quality drop).
sarah (research): We can produce initial quant heuristics by next Wed. Need representative prompt sets.
marcus (solutions): Customer ask: want auto-generated explainability notes when quantization applied.
mara (PM): Good—add to must-have? maybe stretch: explainability -> stretch. Must-have: rollout canary + eval-triggered rollback.
dave (ops): Ops needs alerting spec: eval-triggered alerts feed to incidents channel with diffs and sample prompts.
kevin (eng): On routing: we should support target SLO per route (cost vs p99 latency) and auto-fallback to non-quantized model.
aj (eng-ml): POC code snippet for eval checks:

`````
if drift_score > 0.1:
    trigger_eval_alert()
`````

mara (PM): Nice. Define acceptance: 1) canary rollout to 5% traffic; 2) eval alerts fire with diff samples; 3) documented ops runbook.
sarah (research): Also add guardrails for short prompts — quant can regress more on short context.
marcus (solutions): For customers, need migration notes + sample prompts to validate.
mara (PM): Action items: Kevin -> alerting spec (due Fri), Aj -> quant heuristics + sample evals (due Wed), Sarah -> shortlist prompts + eval thresholds (due Wed), Marcus -> customer comm templates (due Tue). Anyone object?
kevin (eng): No objections. Will sync with eng-infra.
aj (eng-ml): I'll drop the initial notebook in #eng-ml.
ops-bot: New oncall pager created: optimize-toolkit-pilot-alerts
mara (PM): Thanks team :thumbsup:
